Text A. We are the band that performs at six. Jo plays the guitar and Sam sings. Our programme includes jazz and one pop song. We practice in the music room, and we need two helpers to carry our cases.

Text B. Mr King is the guest who tells funny stories. His comedy begins at seven. He uses pictures which pupils drew for him. There is no music in his show. Families can reserve free seats at the office.

Text C. We are the pupils who perform hip hop at half past six. We practice in the hall and use a recording which our teacher chose. Each dancer wears a red shirt. We do not need anyone to carry instruments.
